about: Which fixture set and systems the headline charts show. Every system and set is in eval/results/index.json, the tables in docs/benchmarks.md and the UI regardless; this only picks what goes on the slide-sized charts. Keys are run-record system.key values.

readme.about: The README results table (pii-guard eval report rewrites the block between <!-- results:start --> and <!-- results:end -->). Columns read a fixture set's latest snapshot or a dataset's latest counts; marks are caveats explained under the table in the README, and a column whose best cell is marked gets no bold.
